notes.title: v1.28.779 Release Notes
notes.content:
Updated lighting system
[list][*]Shadows are soft now instead of sharp edges
[*]Lighting shows normal and increased ranges
[*]Each square now has a light level of Darkness, Dim, Normal or Bright light
[/list]

Below is an image of Human Wizard (Binton) with a Hooded Lantern that gives off normal light in a 30 foot radius and increased light for the next 30 feet. The new lighting has soft edges and shows the two regions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36063104/afa5df4e633510fbf2c3375565cb8e17e0bde9ca.png[/img]

This is the same case but the squares are shaded to represent one of the four light levels: Darkness, Dim, Normal or Bright. These light levels will be used for the rules for stuff such as stealth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36063104/24fbcc6ed347b344e2a6c47f4d12fecc721c80d6.png[/img]

Here is Gwenhala the Half-elf Cleric holding a torch that has a range of 20 feet. Gwen has Low Light Vision and so her view in Dim light is twice as far.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36063104/89c2c427607dc0761846011aa3847b59b63d3183.png[/img]

Going forward I intend to work on the following:
[list][*]Hook up a perception system based on the rules. So allowing characters to use stealth.
[*]Work on how the camera moves around to focus on enemy actions that are perceived (seen or heard).
[*]Change how combat starts and ends to be more clear.
[*]Add doors.
[/list]
